# House in Greece for Sale - Full Database Context

This file contains the complete content, context, specifications, and investment blogs of the property listing for the Thessaloniki penthouse apartment, designed for consumption by LLMs and search engines.

## SECTION 1: PROPERTY OVERVIEW & TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

### General Information
- **Street Address**: 1B Elenis Skoura Str., N. Elvetia, Thessaloniki, 54249, Greece
- **Zone**: Residential (East Thessaloniki - high-class residential area)
- **Floor**: 3rd Floor (Penthouse apartment, tiled roof directly above)
- **Year Built**: 2010
- **Total Surface Area**: 82.27 sqm
- **Bedrooms**: 2 Bedrooms (with wooden flooring)
- **Bathrooms/WC**: 1 Bathroom (tiled flooring)
- **Living Room**: 1 (open-plan, tiled flooring)
- **Kitchen**: 1 (fully furnished, tiled flooring)

### Balconies & Orientation
- Airy, bright, and sunny apartment with optimal thermal orientation.
- Nice panoramic views over the eastern side of Thessaloniki.
- Large front balcony with views of the Thessaloniki bay area (Thermaikos Gulf).
- 1 private balcony attached to the master bedroom.
- 1 private balcony attached to the kitchen.

### Heating, Security & Awnings
- **Heating**: Autonomous natural gas heating system (with gas meter).
- **Security**: Double-armored security door at the apartment entrance.
- **Awnings**: Automatic motorized electric awnings on the front balcony.
- **Shutters**: Automatic electric shutters on windows and balcony doors.
- **Windows**: Sliding aluminum framed windows with double-glazed glass doors.
- **Window Protection**: Sunscreen window films pre-applied to filter UV rays and heat.
- **Flooring**: High-quality tiled floors in the living room, kitchen, and bathroom. Hardwood wooden floors in both bedrooms.

### Additional Installations & Building Features
- **Optic Fiber**: High-speed fiber optic connection plug installed inside the apartment.
- **Fireplace**: Pre-installation for a water fireplace (connected to the heating loop).
- **Solar Heater**: Pre-installation for a solar water heater on the roof.
- **Smart Systems**: Pre-installation for an alarm system, built-in surround sound loud speakers, and individual air-conditioning split units.
- **Storage**: Basement storage room (private key).
- **Parking**: Assigned private protective parking slot on the ground floor, one step from the building's main entrance.
- **Elevator**: High-performance lift in the building.
- **Materials**: Resistant, high-quality wood, glass, and aluminum components built to European standards, resilient to humidity.
- **Road Access**: Asphalt type road.

### Fully Equipped Kitchen Specifications
- **Appliance Brands**: Franke, Pitsos, Bosch, Everpure.
- **Dishwasher**: Built-in Pitsos dishwasher.
- **Sink**: Franke 2-bowl fireclay sink with professional stainless-steel professional-style faucet.
- **Water Filter**: Everpure filtration system with a separate custom drinking water faucet.
- **Freezer**: Integrated Bosch freezer and deep freezer unit.
- **Cabinetry**: Large built-in cabinets with heavy storage drawers.
- **Soap Dispenser**: Built-in soap dispenser at the sink basin.

## SECTION 2: NEIGHBORHOOD, COMMUTE, & LOCATION GUIDE

### Commute Times (Walking & Driving)
- **Thessaloniki Airport (SKG)**: 12 km (10-minute drive via direct bypass road).
- **Metro Station**: 3-minute walk (providing rapid transit into central Thessaloniki).
- **Voulgari Bus Terminal**: 7-minute walk (core terminal for city buses).
- **Charilaou Bus Terminal**: 3-minute walk.
- **Ring Road Entrance**: Less than 1-minute drive (immediate access to major highway).
- **Nea Elvetia Park**: 4-minute walk (excellent park for jogging, walking, or coffee).

### Nearby Supermarkets & Shopping Malls
- **AB Vasilopoulos Supermarket**: 7-minute walk.
- **Masoutis Supermarket**: 9-minute walk.
- **Lidl Supermarket**: 1.2 km (3-minute drive).
- **Macedonia Shopping Center (Hypermarket Sklavenitis)**: 3.6 km (5-minute drive).
- **Mediterranean Cosmos Mall**: <5 km (6-minute drive).
- **Leisure**: Coffee Island (2-minute walk), Traditional Greek restaurant "Ouzaki" (2-minute walk).

### Distance to Thessaloniki Landmarks
- **White Tower of Thessaloniki**: 4.3 km (14-minute drive).
- **Arch of Galerius (Kamara)**: 4.7 km (16-minute drive).
- **Aristotelous Square (City Center)**: 5.6 km (22-minute drive).
- **Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki**: 4.0 km (15-minute drive).
